requirements.title: Security and Compliance Infrastructure
requirements.description: Merge of all security, compliance, and infrastructure requirements including encryption, secure protocols, adherence to regulatory standards, mutual TLS, secrets management, OWASP Top 10 vulnerability scan, container image scanning, MFA, IP whitelist, rate limiting, AES-256 encryption for cardholder data, and annual PCI DSS Level 1 certification audit. The system integrates with ML models for fraud detection and verifies KYC documents using Onfido API.

requirements.title: System Performance and Scalability
requirements.description: Merge of all performance, scalability, and system management requirements including system design for high performance, scalability using technologies like Kafka and AWS, payment API latency, merchant dashboard performance, horizontal auto-scaling, database read replicas, multi-AZ deployment, circuit breaker pattern, and system uptime SLA of 99.99%. Payment token returned within 50ms and authorization response from acquiring bank via card network within 200ms.

requirements.title: Payment Processing Architecture
requirements.description: The system follows a microservices architecture on AWS EKS with core services for payment processing, including secure payment gateway, webhook delivery, tokenization, and fraud detection, incorporating exponential backoff for failed transactions.

requirements.title: Data Models
requirements.description: Key data entities include Merchant, PaymentIntent, Transaction, Refund, CardToken, and Subscription, each with specific fields to support payment processing, along with unique reference ID generation and API response envelope for consistency.

requirements.title: Payment Processing Workflow
requirements.description: The cart integration API must accept line items with SKU, quantity, unit price, and tax, validate discount codes and promotional pricing server-side, integrate with merchant shipping provider APIs for shipping cost calculation, and track cart abandonment events. The Standard Payment Workflow is a multi-step process that handles payment processing, including payment intent creation, tokenization, fraud scoring, and authorization.

requirements.title: Hosted Checkout Page Layout
requirements.description: The checkout page uses a single-column centered layout with a white card container on a light-gray background.

requirements.title: Transaction Detail View
requirements.description: The transaction detail view displays the full lifecycle of a transaction, including auth, capture, settle, and refund.

requirements.title: Custom Report Builder
requirements.description: The custom report builder allows merchants to create custom reports with filters for date, currency, payment method, and status.

requirements.title: Bulk Actions
requirements.description: The bulk actions feature allows merchants to perform actions on multiple transactions at once, such as refund or export.

requirements.title: Error Message Handling
requirements.description: Error messages must be localizable and allow keyboard navigation for full error handling without mouse interaction.

requirements.title: Subscription Creation and Customer Checkout
requirements.description: The system creates a Subscription entity, which includes linking it to a Merchant entity via the merchant_id foreign key, a Customer entity via the customer_token foreign key, and a Plan entity via the plan_id foreign key. Customer checkout flow with 10 steps, including payment processing and fraud checking

requirements.title: Real-Time Card Type Detection and Field Validation
requirements.description: The system detects card types in real-time and validates fields on the hosted checkout page without page reload, enhancing the user experience.

requirements.title: Order and Payment Management
requirements.description: The system handles discounts, calculates shipping costs, and applies promotional pricing, ensures cart abandonment tracking, retries failed recurring payments, and sends email notifications for recurring charges, improving payment success rates and supporting subscription and wallet transactions.

requirements.title: PayPal Express Checkout Integration
requirements.description: PayPal Express Checkout is integrated as an alternative payment method, offering customers a quick and secure payment option.

requirements.title: Webhook Notification
requirements.description: The system sends webhook notifications for payment success or failure, keeping merchants informed.
